title: Durpcraft (Fijaxh's Version)
description: Performance mods mostly, with some for fun. Includes a few resource packs and shaders.
body: Based on Fabulously Optimised. A modpack I've created to share with the rest of the Durpeecraft server. Includes A few resource packs and shaders if you want them. Mostly performance mods, but includes bobby mod and distant horizons to increase render distance. Has a couple mods added for QoL like emmisive ores, clear water, shulker tooltips, mouse tweaks, inventory sorting, dynamic lights etc. DOES INCLUDE simple voice chat
